verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a CLI is a community remark that Grok Build runs in a terminal ('terminal is nice', while users wait for a GUI), which implies an official terminal-based coding tool. First-party docs mention Grok Build only as an API model in the quickstart, not as a CLI. missing for 10: first-party documentation of an official CLI (install, commands, auth), evidence of agentic or AI-native workflow features in the CLI, and hands-on corroboration beyond a single passing comment.
